items.headline:
U.S. LOSES 25% OF REAPER DRONE FLEET

The U.S. military has lost at least 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones during the Iran war—roughly 25% of its prewar fleet.

The losses could exceed $1.3B, with some drones reportedly shot down and others crashing after communication failures.

Heavy
